def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    xyz_returns = [0.025, -0.012, 0.038, 0.017, 0.040]
    market_returns = [0.018, -0.005, 0.021, 0.013, 0.035]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    xyz_mean = sum(xyz_returns) / len(xyz_returns)
    market_mean = sum(market_returns) / len(market_returns)

    covariance = sum(
        (xyz - xyz_mean) * (market - market_mean)
        for xyz, market in zip(xyz_returns, market_returns)
    )

    market_variance = sum(
        (market - market_mean) ** 2
        for market in market_returns
    )

    beta = covariance / market_variance
    answer = round(beta, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
